name: EDA Bench Runtime Task Packs
description: Runtime and full task packs for EDA Bench, a benchmark for web-enabled agentic systems that research and reconstruct KiCad PCB projects. Current public source-backed tasks are scored only by an explicit ngspice PCB-geometry and behavioral transient I/O simulation oracle.

rai:dataCollection: Tasks are curated from public open-hardware KiCad designs. Runtime packs contain only prompts and task metadata for mounted agent execution; full task packs contain reference projects, canary answer submissions, grader code, and vendored upstream snapshots.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Public KiCad hardware repositories and release archives listed in the full task-pack source catalogs.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Curated upstream design snapshots are normalized into reference grading projects.
Runtime packs are stripped to prompt.txt, task.toml, task.json, and README.md.
Full task packs include references, task-semantic functional I/O contracts, static I/O contracts, and canaries for grader validation under applicable upstream licenses.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: No human-subject labels are collected. Each task is annotated by the benchmark maintainers with a task id, difficulty bucket, prompt, upstream source metadata, license metadata, runtime/full-pack split, and explicit I/O simulation oracle support status.
rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: Manual curation in the EDA Bench task catalog and generated Hugging Face task packs.
rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Every active task has a frozen pass canary that scores 1.0 under the released oracle and a structural fail canary that scores below the release threshold.
A generated mutation canary sweep on May 6, 2026 validated 35/35 released tasks and 162 generated mutation canaries below the 0.75 threshold on the original 40-task candidate set.
rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Runtime task packs are frozen at Hugging Face revision c64b9169d6d8c0d73614e14c7050cf036aeb1559. Task prompts, source metadata, references, task-semantic functional I/O contracts, static I/O contracts, canaries, and task-pack manifests are hosted in Hugging Face task packs.
rai:dataUseCases: Benchmarking web-enabled agents on public hardware-design reconstruction tasks with explicit disclosure of public-source exposure.
Evaluating KiCad project generation under a fixed harness and deterministic task prompts.
Authoring and validating explicit I/O simulation oracles for public hardware tasks.
rai:dataLimitations: Current public source-backed task scores are limited to refdes-invariant external-I/O semantic verification, PCB-geometry, and behavioral transient I/O simulation oracles.
The default harness is web-enabled and tasks are public, so results should not be interpreted as closed-book electronics synthesis.
Proxy/component/routing/outline similarity scores are disabled and must not be used as substitutes for I/O simulation.
Many tasks need richer calibrated external device, channel, stackup, field-solver, IBIS, SPICE, or S-parameter models for high-fidelity behavior beyond the current generic oracle.
Historical public releases may contain source snapshots or answer canaries; benchmark claims should identify the exact task-pack revision used.
rai:dataBiases: Task coverage reflects public KiCad projects selected by maintainers and is not a representative sample of all PCB design work.

The current oracle favors known external-I/O partitions, simulated board-level I/O waveform behavior, and routed-copper geometry profiles and does not equally cover all analog, digital, RF, power, or high-speed protocol behavior.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: No intentional human-subject or personal data. Upstream hardware repositories may contain author names, commit metadata, or attribution text in documentation.
rai:dataSocialImpact: EDA Bench can help measure progress in hardware-design agents, but generated boards require human engineering review before manufacture or deployment. Misinterpreting benchmark scores as electrical safety or regulatory approval would be an unsafe use.
